## Former PhD students

```{=html}
<article class="project-card" aria-labelledby="david-name">
<p class="eyebrow">Former PhD student · PhD 2025</p>
<h3 id="david-name">David Ferrer-Ferrando</h3>
<p>David was my PhD student at the University of Castilla-La Mancha, co-supervised with Pelayo Acevedo. His research explores habitat selection across individuals, populations and species, combining wildlife monitoring, camera traps, telemetry and spatial modelling.</p>
<p>He defended his thesis, <a href="https://produccioncientifica.ucm.es/documentos/690a507235a17033cdba296b"><em>Crossing borders: associating information across different levels of habitat selection, from the individual to the species</em></a>, in July 2025.</p>
```
